title: No real data on the origin of American democracy: a few dots, then suddenly a huge democracy

sections.name: owner
sections.label: Owner's words (2026-11-08, Claude Code, muDemocracy.org)
sections.content:
"so, one of the challenges for part 2 is that we don't present any real data on the origin of american democracy.

We show what looks like a few dots ... and then suddenly a huge democracy."

sections.name: derived
sections.label: Derived (suggestion)
sections.content: The story's central case (small democracy grows into a nation) is the American one, and it is the one the data parts show least: the underneath map has dated pins but no counts before 1800, and the nations map lights the whole modern-border United States at once in 1800. Showing the growth needs a colonial series (towns with town meetings, assemblies, the colonial franchise) from before V-Dem's coverage begins. Follows vignette 24a34cbb.
